title: High Wind Warning by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
5 minutes ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2025-11-06 00:25:00 EST Expires: 2025-11-06 08:00:00 EST Urgency: Expected Severity: Severe Certainty: Likely Instruction: Remain in the lower levels of your home during the windstorm, and avoid windows. Watch for falling debris and tree limbs. Use caution if you must drive. Target Area: Northern Berkshire; Southern Berkshire; Southern Herkimer; Southern Fulton; Montgomery; Northern Saratoga; Schoharie; Western Schenectady; Eastern Schenectady; Southern Saratoga; Western Albany; Eastern Albany; Western Rensselaer; Eastern Rensselaer; Western Greene; Eastern Greene; Western Columbia; Eastern Columbia; Western Ulster; Northern Fulton; Southern Washington; Bennington; Western Windham; Eastern Windham * WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.
* WHERE...Mohawk Valley, Greater Capital District, southern VT, western Massachusetts, and northern and eastern Catskills.
* WHEN...Until 8 AM EST this morning.
* IMPACTS...Damaging winds will blow down trees and power lines. Scattered power outages are expected. Travel will be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Confidence in wind gusts exceeding 50mph has decreased but the window of opportunity for wind gusts up to 50mph continues through early this morning. Such strong winds can result in downed tree limbs and scattered power outages. Therefore, we will maintain the high wind warning until the threat ends. Gusty winds reaching up to 30 to 40mph will continue through the day today which may result in additional impacts.
